integrity: Finite-support graph and BFS were enumerated exhaustively; mathematical deductions about finite-state Markov chains and Wasserstein optimality were independently reconstructed in the same review. No claim of external certification or complete literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: Certified by exact finite enumeration only for integer grid denominators 2 through 65536; uniform rational grid with exact evaluation then one unbiased rounding step, not IEEE floating point. Related 2011 integer-rounding article not accessible in full; originality risk remains.
title: An exact absorbing-class phase diagram for stochastically rounded logistic dynamics on 16-bit uniform grids
